15:1: Alif Lam Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
15:2: Sometimes those who disbelieve wish that they had been Muslims.
15:3: Leave them to eat, to enjoy, and let hope distract them; soon they will know.
15:4: We did not destroy any land without it having a known decree.
15:5: No community can advance its appointed time, nor can they postpone it.
15:6: And they said: "O you upon whom the Dhikr has been sent down, surely you are indeed a madman."
15:7: Why do you not bring the angels to us, if you are of the truthful?
15:8: We do not send down the angels except with the truth, and then they would not be granted respite.
15:9: Surely We, We sent down the Dhikr, and surely We are its protectors.
15:10: And certainly, before you We sent messengers among the groups of the former generations.
15:11: No messenger came to them but that they mocked him.
15:12: Thus We insert it into the hearts of the criminals.
15:13: They do not believe in it, and the way of the former peoples has certainly passed away.
15:14: And even if We opened a gate from heaven to them and they were ascending into it,
15:15: They would say: "Only our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we are a bewitched people."
15:16: And certainly, We placed constellations in the sky and adorned it for those who look.
15:17: And We protected it from every expelled devil.
15:18: Except whoever steals a hearing, a bright flame pursues him.
15:19: And the earth We spread out, and We placed therein firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of everything well-measured.
15:20: And We made therein livelihoods for you, and for those whom you are not providers of sustenance.
15:21: And there is not a single thing but that its treasures are with Us, and We do not send it down except with a known measure.
15:22: And We sent the winds as pollinators, then We sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink, and you are not its keepers of treasures.
15:23: And surely We, indeed We give life and cause death, and We are the inheritors.
15:24: And certainly, We know those who preceded among you, and certainly, We know those who lag behind.
15:25: Surely your Rabb, He will gather them. Surely He is Wise, Knowing.
15:26: And certainly, We created man from dry clay, from black molded mud.
15:27: And the jinn We created before from smokeless fire.
15:28: And when your Rabb said to the angels: "I am going to create a human being from dry clay, from black molded mud."
15:29: When I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, immediately fall down to him prostrating.
15:30: Thereupon, the angels prostrated, all of them together,
15:31: Except Iblis; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
15:32: He said: "O Iblis! What is the matter with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
15:33: He said: "I am not one to prostrate to a human being whom You created from dry clay, from black mud."
15:34: He said: "Then get out of there, for surely you are expelled."
15:35: And surely the curse is upon you until the Day of Judgment.
15:36: He said: "My Rabb, then grant me respite until the Day they are resurrected."
15:37: He said: "Surely you are of those granted respite until the time of the known Day."
15:38: Until the Day of the known time.
15:39: He said: "My Rabb, because You have led me astray, I will surely make beauties attractive to them on earth and I will surely mislead them all,"
15:40: Except, among them, Your sincere servants.
15:41: He said: "This is a straight path incumbent upon Me."
15:42: Surely over My servants you have no power, except those among the deviators who follow you.
15:43: And surely Hell is the promised place for all of them.
15:44: It has seven gates; for each gate there is an assigned portion of them.
15:45: Surely the righteous are in gardens and by the springs.
15:46: "Enter therein in peace and security," it is said.
15:47: And We removed whatever rancor was in their breasts; they are brothers on facing couches.
15:48: No fatigue touches them there, nor will they be removed from there.
15:49: Inform My servants that surely I am the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful,
15:50: And My punishment, it is the painful punishment.
15:51: And inform them of Abraham's guests.
15:52: When they entered upon him, they said: "Peace." He said: "Surely we are afraid of you."
15:53: They said: "Do not fear, surely we give you good tidings of a knowledgeable son."
15:54: He said: "Do you give me good tidings when old age has touched me? With what then do you give good tidings?"
15:55: They said: "We have given you good tidings with the truth, so do not be of those who despair."
15:56: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Rabb except those who have gone astray?"
15:57: He said: "Then what is your business, O messengers?"
15:58: They said: "Surely we have been sent to a criminal people,"
15:59: Except the family of Lot; we will surely save them all,
15:60: Except his wife; We decreed, surely she will be of those who remain behind."
15:61: When the messengers came to the family of Lot, he said: "Surely you are an unknown people."
15:62: He said: "Surely you are an unknown people."
15:63: Rather, we have come to you with that about which they doubt.
15:64: And we have come to you with the truth, and surely we are truthful.
15:65: So travel with your family in a part of the night and follow behind them, let none of you look back, and proceed to where you are commanded.
15:66: And We decreed to him this command: Surely their root will be cut off in the morning.
15:67: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
15:68: He said: "Surely these are my guests, so do not disgrace me."
15:69: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.
15:70: They said: "Did we not forbid you from the worlds?"
15:71: He said: "Here are my daughters, if you are to do so."
15:72: By your life, surely in their intoxication they were wandering blindly.
15:73: So the blast seized them at the dawn.
15:74: Thus We turned it upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.
15:75: Surely in that there are indeed signs for those who take heed.
15:76: And surely it is indeed on an enduring road.
15:77: Surely in that there is indeed a sign for the believers.
15:78: And surely the people of Aykah were wrongdoers.
15:79: Thereupon We took retribution from them, and surely both of them are on an open road.
15:80: And certainly, the people of Hijr denied the messengers.
15:81: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.
15:82: And they used to carve homes out of the mountains in security.
15:83: The blast seized them in the morning.
15:84: So whatever they used to earn did not avail them at all.
15:85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with truth. And surely the Hour is indeed coming. So forgive with a gracious forgiveness.
15:86: Surely your Rabb, He is the All-Creator, the All-Knowing.
15:87: And certainly, We gave you the seven repeated verses and the great Qur'an.
15:88: Do not extend your eyes toward what We have given to some pairs among them, do not grieve over them, and lower your wings to the believers.
15:89: And say: "Surely I, I am the clear warner."
15:90: Just as We sent down upon those who divided.
15:91: To those who made the Quran into pieces.
15:92: Then, by your Rabb, We will surely question all of them.
15:94: So openly proclaim what is commanded and turn away from the mushriks.
15:95: Undoubtedly, We are sufficient for you against those who mock.
15:96: Those who make another deity along with Allah, so soon they will know.
15:97: And by oath, We surely know that your chest is constricted from the things they say.
15:98: So glorify with the praise of your Rabb and be among those who prostrate.
15:99: And worship your Rabb until certain knowledge comes to you.
